info.description: Production-ready RESTful API for Movie Ticket Reservation System built with Golang, Gin, GORM, and PostgreSQL.
info.title: Movie Ticket Booking REST API

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token

get.description: Get authenticated user profile from token

post.description: Register a new account with email, name, password

get.description: Get paginated list of cinemas with optional city filter
Get paginated list of movies with optional search, sorting, and genre filter

parameters.description: Field to sort by (e.g. release_date, rating, title)
parameters.name: sort_by

put.description: Update movie details by ID (Admin only)

delete.description: Soft delete a movie by ID (Admin only)

get.description: Get paginated list of showtimes with filters for movie, cinema, or date (YYYY-MM-DD)

post.description: Create a showtime for a movie and cinema (Admin only)

get.description: Retrieve showtime details including available seats
Get paginated list of all tickets across the system (Admin only)

post.description: Book a seat for a specific showtime. Uses database transaction to prevent double booking.

get.description: Get paginated list of tickets belonging to authenticated user

patch.description: Update status of a ticket (Admin only)

get.description: Get paginated list of users (Admin only)
Get user details by user ID
